eventCamera.title: Event Camera
eventCamera.description: During the event, guests take photos and videos straight from their phones through a digital disposable camera — no app download needed. Every shot lands in one shared gallery automatically.

highlights.title: No app required
highlights.body: Guests just open a link in their phone's browser and start shooting.

highlights.title: Shared gallery
highlights.body: Every photo and video collects into one living gallery in real time.

highlights.title: Host control
highlights.body: Download, curate, and share the full collection after the event.

eventCamera.imageAlt: Guests taking photos with the event camera

voiceGuestbook.title: Voice Guestbook
voiceGuestbook.tagline: A voice that still feels alive years later.
voiceGuestbook.description: Instead of writing, guests leave voice toasts and heartfelt words straight from their phones. The tone, the laughter, the emotion — all captured exactly as it was.

highlights.title: Record in one tap
highlights.body: Guests tap a button, leave a message, and send it — in under 30 seconds.

highlights.title: Organized archive
highlights.body: Every voice message is sorted by name and time.

highlights.title: A memory to revisit
highlights.body: Hosts can listen back later or share it with loved ones.

voiceGuestbook.imageAlt: A guest leaving a voice message on their phone

lettersFromTheRoom.title: Letters From the Room
lettersFromTheRoom.description: Guests write private letters during the event — heartfelt wishes and memories that collect into one digital keepsake, opened after the event ends.

highlights.title: Write from any device
highlights.body: Guests write straight from the link, no printed cards needed.

highlights.title: One shared keepsake
highlights.body: Every letter collects into a single, beautifully formatted digital book.

highlights.title: Open on your own time
highlights.body: The collection can open on the event day or later — your call.

lettersFromTheRoom.imageAlt: A guest writing a private letter at the event

disposableCamera.title: Disposable Camera Mode
disposableCamera.description: Guests shoot photos in a playful disposable-camera style, right from the browser — grainy filter, shutter sound, and all. Every shot merges into the shared gallery the moment it's taken, so the whole night builds into a living reel in real time.

highlights.title: One tap, one frame
highlights.body: No settings to fuss over — guests just point, shoot, and get back to the party.

highlights.title: Instant gallery merge
highlights.body: Every photo lands in the shared collection automatically, no separate upload step.

highlights.title: Authentic, unfiltered
highlights.body: The nostalgic camera effect captures the night's mood exactly as it felt in the room.

disposableCamera.imageAlt: Guests toasting while a disposable camera captures the moment

hiddenMoments.title: Hidden Moments
hiddenMoments.tagline: Some moments are worth the wait.
hiddenMoments.description: Guests and hosts can tuck away photos, videos, or notes that stay hidden until a moment you choose — a birthday, an anniversary, or any date that matters. What's captured tonight quietly waits to resurface exactly when it should.

highlights.title: Set your own reveal date
highlights.body: Choose any future date or occasion, and the moment stays locked until it arrives.

highlights.title: Layered surprises
highlights.body: Multiple hidden moments can unlock at different times, spacing the joy out over time.

highlights.title: A private time capsule
highlights.body: Only the people you choose can see each moment once it unlocks.

hiddenMoments.imageAlt: A couple sharing a quiet, private moment at the event

livePolls.title: Live Event Polls
livePolls.tagline: Let the guests steer the night.
livePolls.description: Guests vote in real time on the music, the next toast, or the mood of the room — straight from their phones. Results appear on screen instantly, turning every table into part of the show.

highlights.title: Vote from any phone
highlights.body: No app, no login — guests open the link and cast their vote in seconds.

highlights.title: Instant live results
highlights.body: Answers update on screen in real time as votes come in.

highlights.title: Fully customizable questions
highlights.body: Hosts create polls about music, moments, or anything worth asking the room.

livePolls.imageAlt: Guests enjoying a lively celebration together

sharedGallery.title: Shared Gallery
sharedGallery.description: Every photo and video captured by every guest — from every camera and every feature — flows into a single, beautifully organized gallery. No more piecing memories together from a dozen phones after the fact.

highlights.title: One gallery, every guest
highlights.body: Shots from Event Camera, Disposable Mode, and uploads all collect in one place automatically.

highlights.title: Sort and browse with ease
highlights.body: Filter by time, favorites, or contributor to relive the night the way you want.

highlights.title: Download the whole night
highlights.body: Hosts can export the complete collection in one click, ready to keep forever.

sharedGallery.imageAlt: Guests gathered together at a rooftop celebration

messageForLater.title: Message for Later
messageForLater.tagline: A little suspense makes memories sweeter.
messageForLater.description: Photos and messages from the event stay locked until 9:00 AM the next morning, so the night ends on a cliffhanger instead of a scroll. When the gallery finally unlocks, guests wake up to the whole story at once.

highlights.title: Built-in anticipation
highlights.body: Everything captured during the event stays sealed until the reveal time.

highlights.title: One shared unlock moment
highlights.body: All guests see the gallery open together the next morning, not staggered.

highlights.title: Worth the wait
highlights.body: The delay turns ordinary photos into a proper morning-after surprise.

messageForLater.imageAlt: A guest handing over a keepsake message at the event

timeCapsule.title: Digital Time Capsule
timeCapsule.tagline: Written today, opened years from now.
timeCapsule.description: Guests leave letters, photos, and videos sealed inside a digital time capsule that opens on a date you choose — a first anniversary, a milestone birthday, or any day worth waiting for. What's said tonight arrives exactly when it matters most.

highlights.title: Choose the opening date
highlights.body: Set any future date, from one year out to a decade, and the capsule stays sealed until then.

highlights.title: Every format welcome
highlights.body: Letters, photos, and videos all live together inside the same capsule.

highlights.title: A reminder, right on time
highlights.body: Everyone gets notified the moment the capsule is ready to open.

timeCapsule.imageAlt: A couple embracing at their celebration, a memory to open later

videoMessages.title: Video Messages
videoMessages.tagline: Say it on camera, keep it forever.
videoMessages.description: Guests record short video greetings and toasts straight from their phones — no camera crew required. Every clip is stitched into one shared archive the host can revisit anytime.

highlights.title: Record in seconds
highlights.body: Guests tap record, say their piece, and send — right from the event link.

highlights.title: One shared reel
highlights.body: All video messages collect into a single archive, organized and ready to watch.

highlights.title: Relive it anytime
highlights.body: Hosts can rewatch, download, or share every message long after the event ends.

videoMessages.imageAlt: A digital invitation displayed across devices, ready for video messages

eventArchive.title: Event Archive
eventArchive.tagline: Everything from the night, kept for good.
eventArchive.description: After the event ends, every photo, message, and memory collects into one lasting digital archive — organized, searchable, and safe for years to come. Nothing gets lost in a camera roll or forgotten in a group chat.

highlights.title: Everything in one place
highlights.body: Photos, voice messages, letters, and videos all live together in a single archive.

highlights.title: Built to last
highlights.body: The archive stays accessible for years, long after the event is over.

highlights.title: Easy to revisit and share
highlights.body: Hosts can browse, export, or share the full archive anytime they like.

eventArchive.imageAlt: An elegant candlelit table setting, a memory preserved from the event
